name: Golden Image Label
description: The raster document behind the RO-111 golden artifacts: one JPEG asset drawn into a 40 x 16 mm box with preserve_aspect_ratio, so the image XObject, its /DCTDecode stream, the fitted and centred box and the /Do placement are pinned by exact bytes, and a frame rectangle pins the placement against it. The JPEG is carried unchanged in both formats; the PNG counterpart is pinned by the unit tests, whose rows PostScript paints with the scanlines unfiltered.
